workarounds.note: every symbol is imported from esm.sh/postext?bundle and initMathEngine() is awaited before the build
a display formula with \tag renders 0 wide: numbered() rewrites each tagged equation into \mathmakebox boxes as wide as the column, with the number flush right

maths is drawn with 1 ex = half the font size: math.fontSizeScale 0.94 matches its x-height to STIX Two Text (retune it when the scale is fixed), and MATH_EM measures the em the equation-number boxes are drawn in

U+00A0 breaks like a normal space: percentages are closed up (0.08%), multiple citations written [4,6] and [8,9], and a sentence whose 'Eq. (1)' split at a line end names the textbook formula instead; check that no Eq. or Section ends a line
headings.balancing.stretchAfterFloats is off, so the columns under Figure 3 on the closing page start level
the author marks in the title block are the characters ¹ and ², since design text prints ^1^ literally
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
a display formula does not keep with its lead-in line: the copy is fitted, and figures go to the head of a column (position 'top') so no lead-in stands above one with its equation beyond
the paragraph after a display formula is always indented: each one opens a new sentence ('Here L is…') instead of a LaTeX-style 'where…'
in-column headings take no letterSpacing: the back-matter headings are untracked capitals (textTransform uppercase)

on a closing page under a page-wide top float, a heading that opens a column is still a balancing lever (stretchAfterFloats: false does not switch it off) and drops a grid line, so the column heads no longer align; the back matter is fitted so no heading opens column 2 of p. 216
